findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is not enabled, weakening long-term cryptographic hygiene for the audit trail key.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No policy attribute is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy granting full access (kms:*) to the account root, which can allow any IAM principal with sufficient IAM permissions to use or manage the key, rather than restricting usage to only the entities that need to encrypt/decrypt the audit trail data.
